title: BTC GAS-t negative paper repo initialization — structured 24-step checklist

gate_questions.question: Target journal final decision: JoEF primary (K1214 default) or pivot to JFEC (Catania 2018 home)?
Title wording: keep 'Why GAS-t Fails on Bitcoin: Student-t Innovation Is the Culprit, Regime-Switching Cannot Rescue' or soften 'Fails'/'Culprit'?
Bibliography expansion scope: 16 entries (K1214) or expand to 25-30 before Phase 2? or defer to Phase 5?
Figure PDF generation: fresh from K1129/K1133/K1133b in Phase 3, or soft-link PNG now and defer PDF to Phase 5?
Orphan K resolution: keep K1133 P2/P3 preliminary caveat in paper, or drop for cleaner narrative?

paper_metadata.working_title: Why GAS-t Fails on Bitcoin: Student-t Innovation Is the Culprit, Regime-Switching Cannot Rescue

phases.name: Skeleton
phases.goal: Folder hierarchy + 5 self-contained stub files so compliance is baseline-green from commit 1.

steps.action: mkdir -p paper/btc-gas-negative/{scripts,results,figures,data,review_history}
Write paper/btc-gas-negative/README.md (title, target journal, status=draft, K-list, 2-line data summary)
Write paper/btc-gas-negative/experiments.md (K1129 + K1133 + K1133b one-line each)
Write paper/btc-gas-negative/data_sources.md (yfinance BTC-USD 2015-01-02 to 2026-04-14, n=4121, seed=42, retrieval date)
Write paper/btc-gas-negative/main.tex skeleton (xeCJK preamble, \input{body_v1}, \bibliography{references})
Write paper/btc-gas-negative/body_v1.tex skeleton (Introduction through Conclusion placeholder headers)
git commit -m 'paper/btc-gas-negative/ repo skeleton initialized (K1228 guide phase 1)'

phases.name: LaTeX cherry-pick from K1214
phases.goal: Populate body_v1.tex with full content from K1214 draft, numbers verbatim.

steps.action: Open experiments/k1214/k1214_paper_draft.md alongside body_v1.tex in editor
Section-by-section Markdown-to-LaTeX conversion (# -> \section, tables -> booktabs, $...$ inline math, refs -> \citep)

Populate references.bib with 16 starter entries from K1214 (Bollerslev 1986, GJR 1993, CKL 2013, Catania 2018, Klaassen 2002, Patton 2011, HLN 1997, Harvey 2016, Hansen-Lunde 2005, Hwang-Valls-Pereira 2006, Chu et al 2017, Hamilton 1989, Gray 1996, Nelson 1991, Harvey 2013, Blasques-Koopman-Lucas 2015, Diebold-Mariano 1995)
Optional bibliography expansion (Katsiampa 2017, Baur-Dimpfl 2018, Haas et al 2004, Bauwens et al 2014) per user gate Q3
Verify canonical numbers verbatim (t=-4.58, t=-4.67, t=+2.67, t=+5.97, t=+0.28; 75%/25% attribution)
git commit -m 'paper/btc-gas-negative/ body_v1.tex populated from K1214 draft (K1228 guide phase 2)'

phases.name: Reproducibility package
phases.goal: Three-way consistency (script <-> data <-> paper) per docs/paper-guide.md.

steps.action: Write scripts/reproduce_all.py (wrapper invoking K1129/K1133/K1133b entry scripts)
Write scripts/README.md (per-Table/Figure mapping to source experiments)
Export results/table1_full_sample.csv, table2_subperiod_dm.csv, table3_5model_decomposition.csv, table4_ms_gas_rescue.csv from K1129/K1133/K1133b JSONs
Convert K1129/K1133/K1133b PNG figures to PDF via matplotlib.savefig or soft-link PNG (per user gate Q4)
Write top-level reproduce.py (runs scripts/reproduce_all.py, diffs vs paper body, writes reproduce_report.json)
Run uv run python paper/btc-gas-negative/reproduce.py; verify reproduce_report.json all match_bool=true (apply paper-guide.md (a)/(b)/(c) if mismatch)
git commit -m 'paper/btc-gas-negative/ reproduction package complete (K1228 guide phase 3)'

phases.name: Compile + paper-upsert
phases.goal: First PDF build + paper registered in platform for paper-review-cycle to target.

steps.action: cd paper/btc-gas-negative && xelatex main.tex && bibtex main && xelatex main.tex && xelatex main.tex (no undefined refs / missing citations)
uv run volpred ops paper-upsert --paper-id btc-gas-negative --title 'Why GAS-t Fails on Bitcoin' --target-journal 'Journal of Empirical Finance' --status draft
uv run volpred ops paper-upload-pdf --paper-id btc-gas-negative --pdf paper/btc-gas-negative/main.pdf
git commit -m 'paper/btc-gas-negative/ initial compile + paper-upsert (K1228 guide phase 4)'

phases.name: Review cycle
phases.goal: Iterate body_v2/v3 via paper-review-cycle skill until ready_for_submission.
phases.steps_summary: Invoke paper-review-cycle; archive rounds in review_history/v{n}/; iterate body_v{n+1}.tex via paper-update; stage transitions per paper-stage-classifier (draft -> review -> ready_for_submission -> submitted).

submission_prep_checklist: All 5 self-contained items present (data_sources.md / scripts/README.md / results/ / experiments.md / README.md)
reproduce_report.json all-green match vs paper body numbers (rerun on clean env)
data_sources.md lists full API endpoint, retrieval date, license/TOS note (yfinance fallback to Binance/Kraken)
References bib verified via citation-verifier skill (DOI, authors, year)
Target journal format checklist (JoEF: abstract <= 200 words, keywords 3-6, AMS/JEL subject class)
Cover letter draft in cover_letter.tex (novelty, fit, first-submission status)
Orphan K references in experiments.md resolved or tagged 'unused in final draft'
Main-thread final review of body_v{n}.tex (no agent-written .tex)

risk_register.mitigation: data/ cache snapshot + Binance/Kraken fallback in data_sources.md
PRELIMINARY flag in Table 2; main text anchors on P1 (n=1441)
JoEF primary; JFEC backup with explicit 'tests and falsifies a JFEC claim' framing
Limitations section 5.6 acknowledges; flag as future work

risk_register.risk: Negative-result papers face higher rejection rate
risk_register.mitigation: Target JoEF for receptivity; cover letter emphasizes decomposition methodology as generalizable contribution
